'''Dair Coladel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In her youth, Dair Coladel enjoyed consuming [[kelsen-briar]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]], which [[Dair Coladel's father|her father]] often caught her stealing. She was stationed aboard a Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starship]] orbiting the [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] shortly after the pivotal [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. While most of the Alliance's personnel were celebrating their victory on the surface of the moon, Coladel was one of the few individuals to remain on duty to monitor the immediate [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around the Alliance [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and the remnants of the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Tired and hungry after being on duty for fourteen hours, Coladel soon detected an unidentified energy spike in the low band [[Subspace/Legends|subspace]] range originating from Endor. She initially believed it to be a residual shock wave from the Death Star's destruction, but, following her instincts, she decided to notify her [[Commander/Legends|commander]] about the spike.
